svg.aria-label: How the pairs of one query fall into groups and which way the loss pushes each. The query puts a box on the dog in the lower right of its image. With its own image it is inside: its score is pulled up, weight 1. Against the other 255 images it is outside where a dog lies clear of the window (pushed down, weight 0.35), absent where there is no dog and no shared word (pushed down, weight 0.5, about 200 images per query), and unsupervised where a dog sits inside the window (not in the loss, about 54). Its moved-window copy is outside with its own image (pushed down, weight 0.5) and unsupervised with every other image.
svg.text: the other 255 images in the batch
a moved window is paired only with its own image
